nom: PanOxyl Clarifying Exfoliant with 2% Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the product removes excess oil and buildup, reduces breakouts, and helps regulate sebum, though one notes it can be somewhat drying.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several report it dried out or over-dried their skin even with moisturizer, while others with dry-acne-prone skin say it dries out blemishes without irritation or excessive dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it leaves skin feeling light, clean, and smooth, and worked well on stubborn breakouts, though it can be a little over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation or dryness and good results on acne, but a few with non-sensitive or unspecified sensitivity report redness, burning, or stinging on first uses.
segments.normal: One reviewer describing dry-normal skin reports it worked well on acne spots and improved skin texture over time.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports the product is gentler than other acne treatments she has tried and helped without leaving flaky crusts.

concerns.aging: A reviewer in her 40s reports gentle effectiveness on acne without the dryness and flaking she experienced with other products.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report no unusual dryness and comfortable wear even with daily use; however, several others report the product dried out their skin, in some cases despite moisturizing, and recommend easing in slowly or using less frequently.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report the product helped reduce redness or did not cause it, but a few describe their skin turning visibly red or irritated shortly after application, especially on first use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers state the product left their skin barrier intact with no burning or irritation, though one warns that overuse can damage the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report the product dried out blemishes quickly and reduced hormonal or cystic spots, sometimes within days; one reviewer saw no difference after two months.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, cleared blackheads, and improved pore appearance over one to several weeks; a minority report no improvement or even more frequent breakouts after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the product controls excess oil and buildup without making skin more oily, and one notes it strips only some oil while maintaining balance.

aspects.libelle: Initial stinging or burning on application

extraits.titre: Nice product, not for my skin
extraits.texte: I've used panoxyl face wash for a long time so I was excited to try this. It is easy to apply and goes on nicely. However, even with extra moisturizer, it severely dried out my skin. I've used salicylic acid before without irritation; my skin just does not love this particular one. I'm ecstatic panoxyl is expanding their brand though - their adapelene is excellent!

This toner works great on stubborn breakouts. I have combination, acne prone skin, this toner worked great and dried out my blemishes overnight. It can be a little over drying, but it is very effective on breakouts.

I have acne prone and oily skin, and I've been prescribed tretinoin. I still get hormonal breakouts while using it, so I've added this salicylic acid toner to my skincare routine to help exfoliate the whiteheads and blackheads. I like that my skin doesn't feel super dry after using it, and it still does a good job of removing excess oil. I do notice some flaky skin, but that's mostly from the combination of tretinoin and the salicylic acid. I use them at separate times of the day, but it can still sometimes cause dryness and flaking. I've noticed fewer breakouts while using this product, and in the before and after pictures from 6/15, you can see how well it exfoliates and clears the whiteheads. Overall, it works great!￼

I was gifted the PanOxyl 2% Salicylic Acid Clarifying Exfoliant complimentary from PanOxyl and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I've been using AHA exfoliants for a while (mainly glycolic acid) and have never noticed much of a difference in my skin. Since incorporating PanOxyl's Salicylic Acid, a BHA, I finally saw the change in my skin that I was hoping for. BHA's penetrate more deeply than AHA's, and unclog pores while decreasing oil production. My skin texture, typically dull and bumpy, has become glowing and smooth. I did go through a bit of a purging stage, which is to be expected, but this was gentle on my skin and did not cause any burning, redness, or irritation. My skin barrier has remained intact! It is fragrance free (another plus… scented products can be irritating to my sensitive skin) and cost effective. I absolutely recommend this product. It has taken my skin from dull and flat to bright and supple.

This product helped clear the blackheads from my nose. It also reduced the appear of my pores on my cheeks. I do recommend using one time a week only to avoid a breakout. Using this product too often can damage the skin barrier.

extraits.titre: A M A Z I N G, nothing less
extraits.texte: I've been using PanOxyl Clarifying Exfoliant 2% Salicylic Acid for a while, and it's really helped clear up my acne. It does a great job of keeping my pores clear and preventing new breakouts. I have oily skin, so it works well for me, but it can be a bit drying. I just make sure to moisturize afterward. Overall, it's been effective, but if you have sensitive skin, I'd suggest starting slow.

I have sensitive skin and this worked great for me without causing any irritation or dryness. I apply one application in the morning. Within the first three days of using this clarifying exfoliant I could see a noticeable difference. My skin seems brighter and my acne has definitely improved.
